options.content: Frame-level drilldown. Narrow the time range and variables to inspect one incident.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts, e.topic, e.event_type, e.payload FROM mm_events e WHERE e.topic = '${diagnostics_topic}'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND ($__timeFilter(e.ts)) ORDER BY e.ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ts, topic, event_type, payload FROM mm_events WHERE event_type = 'StrategyDecision'
  AND exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ts, topic, event_type, payload FROM mm_events WHERE topic = '${target_books_topic}'
  AND event_type = 'JointTargetBook'
  AND exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ts, topic, event_type, exchange, symbol, actor_id, payload
FROM mm_events
WHERE topic LIKE 'execution:%'
  AND exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR symbol IS NULL)
  AND $__timeFilter(ts)
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 100

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
    AND event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gates.key AS exchange, e.ts
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND gates.key IS NOT NULL
    AND gates.key <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

SELECT interval_ms
FROM (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) AS interval_ms, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) <> ''
  GROUP BY 1
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
